claims.statement: The default catalog HTTP composition exposes exactly 12 Social media, 6 Blog and SEO, 5 Email, 14 Community and 6 Partnerships instances. Hierarchy nesting and the independent instance-to-template-to-department join agree with advertised counts for all 43 unique IDs; disabled catalog instances remain included and control-plane nodes are not deployments.

The production v1 compiler rejects a coherent catalog mutation that preserves global 5/12/36/43 counts but shifts department deployment counts to 11/7/5/14/6. Distribution-only release-lock tampering is also rejected even when the lock's global counts and semantic hash remain unchanged.

limitations: The API journey uses in-process ASGI transport with default local catalog compilation and identity; no query projection is replaced by a static mock. Browser rendering and deployed network transport are separate requirements.

Disabled-instance coverage changes only isolated catalog copies; it does not claim to exercise persisted configuration edits. A relaxed global-count-only compiler contract is used solely to establish the negative fixture's coherence before the default v1 contract rejects its distribution.
CI remains disabled at user direction. Static review is not completion evidence; the final committed requirement tree must pass all declared local gates.
